# rixl_dashboard (Resource)

Manages an analytics and observability dashboard in Rixl.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_dashboard" "media_metrics" {
  name       = "Streaming Analytics"
  visibility = "org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `visibility` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `org_id` (String)
- `owner_user_id` (String)
- `revision` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `updated_by` (String)
